title: Pre-Award Spending Form — blank sample (image transcription)
content:
[IMAGE TRANSCRIPTION] This document is a verbatim transcription of an IMAGE, not of page text. The image is the blank Pre-Award Spending Form (Advance Account Application) sample image (alt text: Morgan State University ORA Pre-Award Spending Advance Account Application sample image). It is published as https://www.morgan.edu/Images/ADMINISTRATION/OFFICES/ora/Blank_Pre-AwardSpendingForm.png and appears on https://www.morgan.edu/office-of-research-administration/pre-award/pre-award-spending. The text below was read off the image by machine vision and is reproduced as it appears, including its field labels, section numbering and blank entry fields; anything unreadable is marked [unreadable]. Nothing here is summarized or inferred.

MORGAN
